name: Sanger
seo_title: Sanger Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Sanger, California for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Sanger calls itself the Nation's Christmas Tree City, and its December is built around that title: a downtown tree lighting, the Toyland Parade and a yearly trek up to the General Grant Tree in Kings Canyon National Park.
celebrates: The Sanger District Chamber of Commerce leads the season. The Christmas Tree Lighting at Brehler Square comes first, with Santa, train rides, cookies, hot chocolate, kids' games and school choirs, according to the chamber's announcement. The Toyland Parade follows in downtown Sanger, described in its participant materials as a free children's parade that goes ahead rain or shine, with a holiday vendor fair the same day. The second weekend moves outdoors: Kings River Winery hosts a free Small Town Christmas Market, and the chamber and the National Park Service hold the Trek to the Nation's Christmas Tree at Grant Grove.
lastyear: The Sanger Chamber announced the 77th Annual Toyland Parade for 2025 on its Instagram account, with a parade entry application and a November deadline for floats and groups. The 2025 national park calendar page for the Trek described a free public program with caroling, an Honor Guard and a wreath, with chairs provided and no RSVP needed. This year the parade is the 78th and the Trek is the 101st.
facts: The General Grant Tree in Grant Grove was named the Nation's Christmas Tree, and Sanger's yearly trek to it has now run for 101 years, according to the Sequoia and Kings Canyon National Park calendar and the Sanger history page. Sanger carries the title Nation's Christmas Tree City, which is why the tree lighting is called the 43rd annual and the parade is the 78th annual Nation's Christmas Tree City Toyland Parade.
trains: The closest real train ride for families is the Wahtoke Railroad steam train at Hillcrest Tree Farm, 6943 S Reed Ave in Reedley. The farm runs steam train rides and Santa photos on Saturdays and Sundays from November 28 to about December 20, 2026, with train tickets at $5 to $10 for ages 2 and up, plus moonlight Pajama Christmas train nights at $40 per person. We have not found a verified Christmas train event inside town limits.

kidfact: Sanger is known as the Nation's Christmas Tree City because a giant sequoia in Kings Canyon National Park was named the Nation's Christmas Tree.
faq: Why is Sanger called the Nation's Christmas Tree City?

The General Grant Tree in Kings Canyon National Park was named the Nation's Christmas Tree, and Sanger hosts a yearly trek to it with the National Park Service. The 2026 Trek is the 101st. That tie to the tree is why Sanger uses the title on its parade and tree lighting, according to the Sanger chamber and park materials.
Is the Sanger Toyland Parade free?

The participant materials call the Toyland Parade a free celebration and a children's parade, and say it goes ahead rain or shine. A holiday vendor fair runs in downtown the same day, from 8 am to 3 pm. The route had not been published when we checked, so confirm road closures with the Sanger Chamber.
Does Santa come to the Sanger tree lighting?

The Sanger Chamber lists Santa, train rides, cookies, hot chocolate, kids' games and school choirs for the tree lighting at Brehler Square, near 7th and N Streets. No price is printed, so check with the chamber about any ride or food costs.
Is the Trek to the Nation's Christmas Tree open to the public?

The 2025 park page said the program was free and open to the public, with no RSVP and chairs provided. The 2026 page lists no price, so check the park calendar and road conditions before you drive up to Grant Grove.
Are there Sanger library Christmas programs?
We did not find a Christmas specific program at the Sanger Branch Library, 1812 7th St, in the next listings on the Fresno County Public Library calendar. Check the calendar again closer to the date.
